company.name: Larridin
company.shortDescription: Larridin measures AI-powered work. Track ROI on token spend, AI workflows & human/agentic productivity against business outcomes.
company.description:
Larridin Company Overview: Larridin is the measurement layer for enterprise AI. It proves AI's impact across an organization's human and agent workforce, what companies spend on AI, what their teams produce with it, and which workflows to automate next.

What We Do: Larridin is an AI Value Measurement Platform that connects AI spend and adoption to the actual work a company delivers. Instead of static, backward-looking metrics, it gives leaders a real-time, dynamic view of AI usage, cost, proficiency, and business impact, by team, role, and AI application, so they can:
- Trace every dollar of AI spend (licenses, tokens, model costs) to the team, tool, or agent using it
- See how much capacity AI is actually adding, and compare AI ROI across departments
- Benchmark adoption and fluency so leaders know where AI has become real working capability versus just licensed access
- Identify the highest-value workflows to automate next, and track automation against a measured baseline
- Connect engineering delivery, code quality, and velocity to AI spend and agent performance

Platform - Larridin is organized around four core pillars:
- Spend Intelligence — Consolidates token usage, seat licenses, and model costs into one view, tracing every AI dollar to a team, tool, or agent.
- AI Impact — Measures adoption, fluency, and AI-driven capacity by department, and calculates AI ROI (net capacity value vs. spend).
- Developer Intelligence — Connects engineering output, code quality, and delivery velocity to AI spend and agent effectiveness; includes the Larridin Router, Agent Effectiveness, Effort Allocation, and an "Ask AI" natural-language interface.
- Workflow Intelligence — Maps repeated work into an AI Transformation Center, identifying, piloting, and tracking automation opportunities against a captured baseline.
Larridin also publishes Larridin Data, benchmark research on what companies actually pay for AI coding tools. 

Who We Serve: Mid-to-large enterprises across technology, financial services, healthcare, and manufacturing. The platform is built for three buyer roles in particular:

Heads of AI / CIOs — where AI rollout is working, and where to expand or help
CTOs / Engineering leaders — what engineering is actually delivering with AI
CFOs / Finance teams — what AI spend is paying for, reconciled across vendors
Customers: Larridin is used by companies including Vertiv, Gainsight, Klaviyo, SurveyMonkey, TigerConnect, ConnectPay, EcoVadis, Belcorp, Sundt, Globality, The Joint Chiropractic, Source Advisors, Andelyn Biosciences, Polk County (WI), and the University of Hertfordshire.

Leadership Team
Russ Fradin — Co-Founder & CEO (previously Dynamic Signal, Adify, comScore)
Jim Larrison — Co-Founder & President (previously Dynamic Signal, Firstup, comScore)
Ameya Kanitkar — Co-Founder & CTO (previously LinkedIn, Coinbase, Groupon)

Funding & Investors: Larridin has raised $17M in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) — with board member Alex Rampell — alongside Bloomberg Beta, Gradient, Haystack, Homebrew, and Refract.

Trust & Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA. Full detail available via the Larridin Trust Center.

Category & Market Position: Larridin is pioneering the AI Value Measurement category — sitting at the intersection of spend management, workforce analytics, and engineering intelligence — giving leaders the objective, real-time evidence they need to justify and scale AI investment across both human and agentic work.
